description: Implement manager approval workflow and complete routing integration including LeaveApprovalsScreen, route guards, and dashboard navigation updates
steps: Create lib/features/leaves/presentation/blocs/leave_approvals_bloc.dart for manager approval workflow with events for loading pending approvals, approving/rejecting requests
Display pending requests in responsive table/list format with employee details, dates, reason
Implement approve/reject actions with confirmation dialogs and success feedback
Update lib/core/router/app_router.dart to replace placeholder LeavesScreen with LeaveOverviewScreen in leaves branch
Add sub-routes /leaves/apply -> ApplyLeaveScreen and /leaves/approvals -> LeaveApprovalsScreen within leaves branch
Add proper BlocProvider setup for both LeaveBloc and LeaveApprovalsBloc in route builders
Update lib/features/dashboard/presentation/screens/widgets/employee_dashboard_view.dart to navigate to /leaves/apply instead of showing snackbar
Update lib/features/dashboard/presentation/screens/widgets/manager_dashboard_view.dart to navigate to /leaves/approvals for 'View All' button
Verify StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack branch index remains stable when adding sub-routes
acceptance_criteria: LeaveApprovalsScreen is accessible only to managers/HR/admin with proper role checking
Route navigation works correctly: /leaves shows overview, /leaves/apply shows form, /leaves/approvals shows manager view
Dashboard quick action buttons navigate to correct leave screens instead of showing placeholder snackbars
Approve/reject functionality works with proper state updates and user feedback
All route transitions maintain proper BLoC state and don't cause navigation errors
verification: Run `flutter analyze lib/core/router/app_router.dart` and verify no route compilation errors
Test navigation flow: Dashboard -> Apply Leave -> Form, Dashboard -> Approvals -> Manager screen
Verify role-based access by testing with different user roles (employee should not access /leaves/approvals)
Test approve/reject workflow end-to-end with proper state updates
Run full app and verify leave module integration doesn't break existing navigation
